posts.title: Base for Yoto Mini Player
posts.description: I’ve been really enjoying my 3D printer over the last year or so since I got it. Printed many things, some of which I’ve designed myself (and even documented some). Not all are worthy of talking about, but I thought this one was pretty nice. We recently got a Yoto Mini Player (referral link) for our 5 year old with the hope of prolonging when we inevitably buy her a tablet.

posts.title: LEGO is not vegan
posts.description: I’ve been a life-long fan of LEGO. Some of my earliest memories are of either playing with LEGO, and endlessly reading the catalogues (which I’ve still got).
